basic_profile.bio: Recently moved to Dublin, I'm a tech enthusiast exploring the world of PC building and vintage hardware. My interests also include reading P.G. Wodehouse novels and experimenting with dairy-free recipes. I work part-time as a pizza delivery driver and enjoy discussing local politics in my free time. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My interest in technology and PC building is mostly self-taught, driven by a passion for vintage hardware. I often rely on online resources and communities to expand my understanding. My knowledge of literature comes from years of casual reading, particularly enjoying the wit of P.G. Wodehouse.
